trust_decision.summary: Whether a non-admin user may list/load/run a given MCP (deferred) tool is decided by allowed_mcp_tools() reading the user's grant, where a missing grant or mcp_tools=None means unrestricted; the chat pipeline then filters the deferred pool and DeferredToolLoader with that set.

landing_point.why: allowed_mcp_tools() is the named per-user MCP whitelist; returning None for absent grants is the 'missing authorization' the summary describes.

fix_sites.entry_point: chat turn (WS /api/v1 unified_ws, POST chat router, cron chat job) -> AgenticChatPipeline._prepare_deferred_tools
fix_sites.module_kind: authorization helper (inferred site; diff has no hunks)

fix_sites.entry_point: same as above; _current_grant also feeds allowed_optional_tools/exec_override

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: deeptutor/multi_user/grants.py:16-32 (empty_grant default mcp_tools=None) and deeptutor/multi_user/grants.py:74-81 (missing or corrupt grant file falls back to empty_grant); v1 migration documents absent v2 fields as unrestricted at deeptutor/multi_user/grants.py:51-53

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The playground tool-execute endpoint is a developer 'Playground tester' (deeptutor/api/routers/plugins_api.py:5-6,116), not the chat grant path the report describes, so a solver can argue it is a separate debugging feature that sits outside per-user grants.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Partner turns run as a synthetic role='user' identity with no grant file and get their MCP whitelist from mcp_tools_filter; a blanket 'deny MCP when no grant' for every non-admin breaks partners' configured MCP tools. Admins stay unrestricted, and an explicit grant list must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: grant with mcp_tools absent or null, including v1 grants (deeptutor/multi_user/grants.py:67-68)
grant with mcp_tools of a non-list type, normalised to None (deeptutor/multi_user/grants.py:38-39)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Authenticated non-admin calls POST /api/v1/plugins/tools/{tool_name}/execute, which runs any registry tool, MCP adapters included, with no grant check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Documented as a Playground tester endpoint, not the chat path; the router is mounted with _auth only (deeptutor/api/main.py:422-424)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (deeptutor/api/routers) from deeptutor/multi_user and deeptutor/agents/chat

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same as above via the SSE variant POST /api/v1/plugins/tools/{tool_name}/execute-stream
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same playground feature; it falls together with the route above

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Chat tool dispatch executes any registered tool name the LLM emits, with no check against the turn's schema list or the loader's allowed set, so the MCP grant is enforced only at listing/loading time
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The model only sees granted schemas and the manifest says direct calls 'will fail' (deeptutor/runtime/registry/deferred_tools.py:47-52); calling an unlisted name looks like a model-misbehaviour issue, not authorization
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: deeptutor/core/agentic package, two packages away from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Non-admin uses POST /api/v1/plugins/capabilities/chat/execute-stream with bot_id to drive an admin-owned partner chat, which runs as the grantless partner identity with the partner's MCP tools
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Partner management is a neighbouring, admin-gated feature (deeptutor/api/main.py:428-430); this looks like a partner-gate issue, not a user-grant one

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second capability or pipeline (e.g. research) that builds its own deferred pool from registry.deferred_tools() without calling allowed_mcp_tools
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Pool construction is a few lines that are easy to copy; registry.deferred_tools() is public (deeptutor/runtime/registry/tool_registry.py:45-47)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: session-persisted loaded tools (load_loaded_tools) replayed into schemas by a path that skips _is_allowed, e.g. a resume or history rebuild
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Loaded names cross a save/reload boundary through services/mcp/session_state; a maintainer adding a resume path could trust persisted state

O9_family: missing authorization (CWE-862), default-allow per-user tool whitelist
